rules.title: Platform rules
rules.intro: By publishing characters on NewVerse, you agree to follow these rules. Violations are reviewed by moderators.
prohibitedItems: Sexualized content involving minors (under Federal Law 149-FZ and Article 242 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation).
Promotion of drugs, extremism, or terrorism.
Detailed cruelty or violence against people or animals.
Incitement of hatred based on race, nationality, or religion.
Spam or advertising of third-party services.
Copyright infringement (copying characters from protected works without permission).
consequenceItems: 1st violation — the character is hidden from public access and a warning is issued.
